WPMS No.2243 of 2023
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Narendra Bali, Advocate 
for the petitioner.
Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, Additional 
Chief Standing Counsel for the 
State.
Heard.
Admit.
Learned Chief Standing 
Counsel takes notices on behalf of 
respondent nos.1 and 2.
Issue notices to the respondent 
nos.3 to 8. Steps to be taken within 
a week.
Counter affidavit to be filed 
within four weeks.
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed. 
List for final hearing on 
28.11.2023. 
Heard on Stay Application (IA) 
No.1 of 2023.
It is the case of the petitioner 
that the respondent nos.4 to 8 have 
been declared protected workers by 
the respondent no.2 without 
afforded an opportunity of hearing 
to the petitioner. The order-sheet of 
the case has not been filed. It is 
submitted that it has not been 
provided to the petitioner.
Having considered, this Court 
is of the view that stay application 
may only be decided once  respondents are permitted to file 
objections. 
Let the respondents file 
objections.
List on the date fixed. 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
17.08.2023
Sanjay
